1: // Neon Runner – minimal endless runner
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 200;
10: 
11:   // Game settings
12:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
13:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
14:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
15:   const OBSTACLE_WIDTH = 20;
16:   const OBSTACLE_GAP = 150; // distance between obstacles
17:   const SPEED = 4;
18: 
19:   let player = { x: 50, y: height - PLAYER_SIZE, vy: 0, onGround: true };
20: 
21:   // Star field for background effect
22:   const STAR_COUNT = 50;
23:   const stars = [];
24:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
25:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, size: Math.random() * 2 + 1, speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2 });
26:   }
27: 
28:   // Audio assets (small base64-encoded wav)
29:   // Jump sound – short beep
30:   const jumpAudio = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,//uQZAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAWGluZwAAAA8AAAACAAACABAAZGF0YYAAAAA=' );
31:   // Hit / game over sound – lower tone
32:   const hitAudio = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,//uQZAAAAAAABAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAWGluZzAAAAAAABAAAABAAAABAAAAAAAAAA=' );
33:   let obstacles = [];
34:   let frameCount = 0;
35:   let running = true;
36: 
37:   function spawnObstacle() {
38:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'spike' : 'gap';
39:     const x = width;
40:     if (type === 'spike') {
41:       obstacles.push({ type, x, y: height - PLAYER_SIZE, w: OBSTACLE_WIDTH, h: PLAYER_SIZE });
42:     } else {
43:       // gap: just a space the player must jump over; represent as invisible obstacle for collision check
44:       obstacles.push({ type, x, w: OBSTACLE_WIDTH, gap: true });
45:     }
46:   }
47: 
48: let gameOverPlayed = false;
49: function update() {
50:     // Player physics
51:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
52:     player.y += player.vy;
53:     if (player.y >= height - PLAYER_SIZE) {
54:       player.y = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
55:       player.vy = 0;
56:       player.onGround = true;
57:     } else {
58:       player.onGround = false;
59:     }
60: 
61:     // Move obstacles
62:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= SPEED);
63:     // Remove off‑screen obstacles
64:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
65: 
66:     // Update star field for parallax effect
67:     stars.forEach(s => {
68:       s.x -= s.speed;
69:       if (s.x < 0) s.x = width;
70:     });
71: 
72:     // Spawn new obstacles
73:     if (frameCount % Math.floor(OBSTACLE_GAP / SPEED) === 0) spawnObstacle();
74: 
75:     // Collision detection
76:     for (const o of obstacles) {
77:       if (o.type === 'spike') {
78:         const collides =
79:           player.x < o.x + o.w &&
80:           player.x + PLAYER_SIZE > o.x &&
81:           player.y < o.y + o.h &&
82:           player.y + PLAYER_SIZE > o.y;
83:         if (collides) {
84:           running = false;
85:           if (!gameOverPlayed) { hitAudio.play(); gameOverPlayed = true; }
86:         }
87:       } else if (o.type === 'gap') {
88:         // gap is a hole: if player is over the gap and not jumping enough, lose
89:         const overGap = player.x + PLAYER_SIZE > o.x && player.x < o.x + o.w;
90:         if (overGap && player.onGround) {
91:           running = false;
92:           if (!gameOverPlayed) { hitAudio.play(); gameOverPlayed = true; }
93:           break;
94:         }
95:       }
96:     }
97: 
98:     frameCount++;
99:   }
100:

103:   function draw() {
104:     // Background gradient
105:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
106:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
107:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
108:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
109:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

111:     // Neon glow settings
112:     ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
113:     ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
114: 
115:     // draw player (neon cyan, rounded)
116:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00ffff';

124:     ctx.lineTo(player.x + radius, player.y + PLAYER_SIZE);

126:     ctx.lineTo(player.x, player.y + radius);
127:     ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y, player.x + radius, player.y);
128:     ctx.fill();
129:

131:     ctx.shadowColor = '#f0f';
132:     ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
133:     obstacles.forEach(o => {

138:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y + PLAYER_SIZE);
139:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y);
140:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + o.w, o.y + PLAYER_SIZE);
141:         ctx.closePath();
142:         ctx.fill();
143:       } else if (o.type === 'gap') {
144:         // visualize gap as a dark cutout (no glow)
